packageRules.description: repobuddy/.github tags (v1, v2) are this repo's own workflow API versions, cut by hand. The internal self-references (setup-playwright@v2, setup-node-pnpm@v2) carry the moving alias of their own line and move only when a release is cut; a Renovate bump to the next major would cross the line split.
Action bumps merge themselves once CI is green. This replaces the org Mergify rule removed in #57; unlike that rule, `matchUpdateTypes` actually excludes majors.
Majors reach every consumer pinned to a moving major alias the moment they land, so they stay a human decision.
